description_en: Queries the status of simple application servers
description_zh: 查询一个或多个实例的状态
name: ListInstanceStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 simple application server IDs. Separate multiple server IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
parameters.name: page_size
